fit_linear_references: fit linear element references for target properties from a dataset using least squares regression
create_element_references: create a LinearReferences module from a .pt or .npz file or state dict
LinearReferences_dereference: remove linear element references from a target tensor using an AtomicData batch
LinearReferences_forward: add linear element references back to a target tensor using an AtomicData batch
load_references_from_config: load or fit element references for a dataset from a configuration dictionary
